name: chat-renamer-vscode
description: Rename Cursor chats from the first prompt: /chat-rename commands and activation patterns with numbered titles

scripts.package: bun run build && bun run vsce-package

enumDescriptions: Listen to Cursor's chat title change event (cursor.onDidChangeAgentHostSessionCatalogTitle) and rename when the first prompt is a rename request.
Install a beforeSubmitPrompt hook in the Cursor hooks.json that sends rename requests to this extension and blocks lone /chat-rename prompts from the model.
chat-renamer.trigger.markdownDescription: What triggers a rename. Experimental: relies on private Cursor internals and may stop working on a Cursor update.

chat-renamer.activationPatterns.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expressions tested against each line of the first prompt of a chat. A match renames the chat to its first capture group (or the whole match). The title is numbered against other open chats: `abc` becomes `abc2`, and with `def3` and `def5` open `def` becomes `def6`. `/chat-rename` and `/rename-chat` always work and are not numbered. In `hook` mode the patterns are copied into the hook script, which evaluates them with Python's `re`; change the setting to reinstall it.

chat-renamer.worktreePrefixes.markdownDescription: Prefixes of worktree directories, each with its own leading character and connector (`_v-` in `_v-my-slug`). A first prompt such as `/vw-spec-iterate @/path/_v-my-slug`, which is what dragging a worktree folder into the chat produces, renames the chat `my-slug`. Empty by default, which turns this off; Variant fills it from `variant.prefix` in `variants.yaml` unless you list prefixes here.

chat-renamer.renameExistingDays.markdownDescription: How many days back to rename chats that already existed when the editor started. Chats whose first prompt matches an activation pattern or `/chat-rename` are renamed oldest first, numbered per title (`abc`, `abc2`, `abc3`), once per chat. `0` turns it off (default `7`). Changing it applies without a reload; the log lines starting with `[existing-chats]` name this setting and its value.

enumDescriptions: Write `.cursor/hooks.json` in the first workspace folder.
chat-renamer.hookScope.markdownDescription: Which hooks.json receives the hook when `#chat-renamer.trigger#` is `hook`.
